subject.title: feat(ios): add Listen action speaking assistant messages via gateway TTS

question: Should iOS Listen ship as a gateway-backed transcript action once the remaining metadata, i18n, conflict, and device-proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing mobile feature tied to a protected maintainer-labeled canonical issue and a newly merged gateway method, so implementation repair alone cannot settle product acceptance.

options.title: Repair and keep stacked
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the metadata/i18n/rebase/device-proof fixes, then review it as the iOS half of the canonical mobile Listen feature.

options.title: Pause mobile Listen
options.body: Hold this PR and the Android sibling until maintainers explicitly approve the mobile Listen UX and rollout plan.

options.title: Narrow to gateway-only follow-up
options.body: Close or defer the iOS UI branch if maintainers want only the gateway capability for now.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep stacked
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the metadata/i18n/rebase/device-proof fixes, then review it as the iOS half of the canonical mobile Listen feature.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current stacked proposal and has the strongest recent history in both the gateway prerequisite and iOS chat conflict surface.
